features.name: Omen of War
features.description: Frames stay highlighted throughout the bonus.

review:
Spear of Athena mixes respins with a coin reveal. Any win triggers a Goddess Respin and marks its symbols with Flaming Frames, and the respin continues while wins grow or new ones form. If a Fortune symbol is on the grid when the respins end, every frame flips over.

Frames can reveal bronze, silver or gold coins, green or red shields that boost nearby or all coins, or amphoras that collect everything visible. The Omen of War bonus keeps frames active after they're used, so the board fills up. The maximum is 15,000x. It's a richer version of the Le Pharaoh design.
